steps.speaker: Reporter A
steps.content: Phanuel, why did you suddenly walk out of the variety show set? Please give us a statement!

steps.speaker: Reporter B
steps.content: An insider has reported that Phanuel appeared to be in a poor mental state during filming. Is there any truth to that?
Eliza pushes through the press with Phanuel in tow. Under security's cover, she shields Phanuel from the cameras while calling the company for a pickup.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Now what? If the car isn't here in five minutes, don't bother coming in tomorrow.
The voice on the other end barely gets a word in before it gets swallowed up by a wave of screams.

steps.speaker: Fan A
steps.content: Phanuel! Oh my gosh, you're so tiny in person! Please look over here! Can you wish me a happy birthday?!

steps.speaker: Fan B
steps.content: Phanuel, I've always been a huge fan of you! Can I get your autograph?! Phanuel!

The crowd spills from the front steps of the TV station all the way to the curb. The area is packed wall-to-wall. It takes the security all they have just to open up a gap barely wide enough to squeeze through.
Phanuel edges through the gap, head lowered, not saying a word all the while. Clearly, her manager has given her some kind of warning. She doesn't respond to a single question.
Phanuel, can I get a photo with you?!

A gray figure takes advantage of the chaos to push to the front. They lurch sideways and slam into Eliza. She sidesteps on instinct, but in that split second, the reporters surge forward all at once and wedge themselves between her and Phanuel.
Before Phanuel can even register what's happening, a hand clamps around her wrist.
She struggles, trying to break free, until she sees who it is. Her eyes go wide.

You pull her out, going against the tide of the crowd. Somewhere in that sea of people behind you, Eliza is still calling Phanuel's name, but her voice has been all but drowned by the screaming and shutter clicks.
